items.name: STANDARD INSTRUMENT DEPARTURE (SID)

general_criteria.text: Knows and executes published instrument departure, as described in MAIP, flawlessly, without IP assistance and according to Basic Control Standards.
Timely corrects any track deviations.
Always comply with the ATC instructions.

parameters.notes: Τυπωμένη μονάδα '(radials)'· κανονικοποιήθηκε σε degrees (1 radial = 1 μοίρα ραδιοβοηθήματος).

items.name: BASIC A/C CONTROL
execution: SP maintains control of airspeed, altitude, heading under determined tolerances in all phases of flight, such as climb, descent, level off, level flight and turns up to 30° of bank.

general_criteria.text: SP handles the A/C with comfort and ease and use the A/C switches flawlessly.
SP controls the engine power depending on the phase of flight, as determined by Flight Manuals or as it is required in order to maintain flight parameters (altitude, airspeed and heading).
SP handles the aileron, elevator and rudder trim correctly, with comfort and ease, in the full airspeed range, flight and A/C maneuvers.

SP is cognizant of the operation of radio aids and is capable of using them to maintain his/her orientation. Moreover, SP can return to the departure or fly to the alternate airport using flight instruments and radio aids.
Criteria mentioned in the Contact Category corresponding section also apply.

parameters.notes: Το σύμβολο ποδιών είναι U+0384 GREEK TONOS (΄), όχι apostrophe/prime.
Και τα δύο ° είναι γνήσιο U+00B0 DEGREE SIGN.

cross_refs: Criteria mentioned in the Contact Category corresponding section also apply.

execution: SP performs steep turns (45° κaι 60° of bank) using instrument references only.

items.name: CONSTANT AIRSPEED - CONSTANT RATE CLIMBS / DESCENTS AND VERTICAL “S”
items.heading_verbatim: (7), (8), (9) CONSTANT AIRSPEED - CONSTANT RATE CLIMBS / DESCENTS AND VERTICAL “S”
execution: 2/ Climbs / descents at constant airspeed and rate.

general_criteria.text: SP knows and executes climbs / descents at constant airspeed / rate and vertical S, as described in the Techniques and Procedures Manual, without mistakes and IP’s intervention.
A/C control must be smooth, continuous and in a way that does not induce extreme or continuous A/C attitude changes, in order to correct flight parameter deviations.

items.name: UNUSUAL ATTITUDES RECOVERY
execution: SP executes recovery from unusual attitudes with nose up or down using control and performance instruments.
conditions: 1/ IP flies the A/C into unusual attitude
3/ Descent attitude is at least 20° nose down and climb attitude at least 10° pitch up.
4/ Any possible bank is to be expected.

general_criteria.text: Timely and correctly recognizes the type of unusual attitude.
Recovers the A/C in level flight promptly, without flying the A/C into stall or exceeding its limitations, with the minimum loss of altitude and without requiring IP’s intervention
Uses correct instrument flight references IAW AFMAN 11-202 VOL3.

items.name: POINT TO POINT
execution: SP performs fix-to-fix navigation using VOR/DME or TACAN and Direct-to-Fix navigation using GPS (RNAV) IAW Techniques and Procedures Manual and AFMAN 11-202 VOL3.

items.name: HOLDING
execution: SP performs entry and maintain designated pattern IAW Techniques and Procedures Manual and AFMAN 11-202 VOL3 (AIM/ICAO procedures).
conditions: 2/ SP must have acquired ATC clearance prior to execution.

general_criteria.text: Compensates for wind changes without IP’s intervention.
Executes pre-descent checks.
The Basic A/C Control Criteria apply.
Complies with ATC instructions
Enters and remains within Holding airspace according to standardized procedures, as described in AFMAN 11-202 VOL3, without mistakes and IP’s intervention.
